title: guide dont prescribe
rule: Guide, don’t prescribe — merchant in control; enough info to decide.
pass_when: Copy guides with enough to decide; merchant stays in control.
fail_when: Prescriptive copy that removes the decision, or too little to decide.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: NN/g UI-copy / confirmation already-filed verb+noun / no “you can”.
